prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path layout, finish copy/layout, home hint/layout, sign_in incentive/layout/redesign).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) is helpful and delivered multiple winning tests.
Copy changes on the path selection screen (choose_path, copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance.
Notification toggles (home, notification), waiting screen info (home, wait_info), waiting screen redesigns (home, redesign), finish hints (finish, hint), and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently higher than noise-corrected measured results.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Full bleed layout redesign for pet pick friend screen: Redesign the pick friend screen into an immersive full bleed layout featuring full-screen pet artwork. (why: Adoption screen redesigns are proven to perform strongly, and immersive pet artwork improves visual engagement during pet pick.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesign the photo upload screen with a focused spotlight layout centered on custom pet photo selection. (why: Support reported 3 issues with custom pet generation looking wrong; a focused spotlight layout guides clean photo uploads.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive preview flow for adoption certificate: Introduce an interactive pet naming and preview card flow directly on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption step redesigns and interactive visual elements drive completion before the waiting screen step.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality preference selection screen: Add a new personality selection screen in the adoption sub-flow to customize pet desktop behaviors before finishing setup. (why: Users requested more pet customization and had post-onboarding confusion around controlling and interacting with their desktop pets.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Pet color customization sub-flow in friend selection: Add an interactive pet color palette and style selection flow directly within the pick friend screen. (why: Adoption sub-flow enhancements consistently boost conversion and user investment in their chosen mascot.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in load delay recovery hint: Add a retry hint on the sign-in screen to assist users if authentication takes longer than usual. (why: Support received 2 complaints about the sign-in screen stalling or failing to load.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Centered layout redesign for sign-in screen: Switch the sign-in screen to a clean centered layout to eliminate visual distraction during auth. (why: Sign-in step has an 80.1% conversion rate; simplifying visual layout reduces friction for signing in.)
7: [finish, layout] Centered layout redesign for home intro screen: Switch the home intro final screen to a centered layout to clearly focus on the final launch action. (why: Finish step dropoff is high with 64.8% completion and 395s median time; a centered layout accelerates final confirmation.)
8: [home, hint] Background desktop preparation hint on waiting screen: Display a reassuring hint on the waiting screen explaining that desktop engine initialization runs safely in the background. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s, and 3 users wrote support saying the pet failed to appear on desktop or app would not open.)
